 Martha Stewart Praises a $90 Washable Silk Blouse as the Ultimate Stealth Wealth Wardrobe Staple 
 In this story 
 Why Martha Stewart Gave This Under-$100 Top Her Stamp of Approval 
 Myth vs. Reality: Does Quality Silk Require Dry Cleaning? 
 How Quince Silk Essentials Compare 
 Lifestyle mogul Martha Stewart has officially given her stamp of approval to a surprisingly accessible wardrobe essential: a $90 washable silk blouse from direct-to-consumer brand Quince. During a conversation with Quince CEO Sid Gupta on her podcast, Stewart wore the piece herself, examining its manufacturing quality and confirming that luxurious, everyday staples do not require astronomical price tags.
 Stewart paired the brand’s Washable Stretch Silk Split Neck Blouse in Vintage Pink with chocolate-brown pants to create an understated, stealth-wealth look. Rather than relying on high-maintenance designer alternatives, the multimillionaire entrepreneur singled out the direct-to-consumer garment for both its cut and its resilient design.
 The endorsement immediately sparked interest across US fashion circles, especially given Stewart’s notoriously exacting standards for home goods, textiles, and personal style.
 Why Martha Stewart Gave This Under-$100 Top Her Stamp of Approval
 When assessing high-end clothing, Stewart turned her attention straight to the garment construction. She scrutinized the hemline and seam work, finding details that typically appear only on far more expensive luxury labels.
 “I always look at the stitchery, and you have many, many stitches per inch. That’s the sign of a very good manufacturer.”
 Stewart also pointed out the fabric’s natural resilience right out of the box. Even without formal preparation, the blouse maintained a smooth drape on camera.
 “We didn’t even steam it, and it still looks okay.”
 Martha Stewart and a man sitting side by side on a wicker couch, with Martha Stewart wearing a pink silk shirt. 
 Crafted from premium mulberry silk infused with a touch of stretch, the top balances classic sheen with everyday flexibility. Its defining feature remains practical care: owners can bypass costly professional dry cleaners entirely.

 Myth vs. Reality: Does Quality Silk Require Dry Cleaning?
 For decades, shoppers operated under the assumption that delicate silk garments must be dry-cleaned to prevent damage, shrinking, or losing their luster. Direct-to-consumer textile advancements challenge that conventional thinking.
 The Common Misconception: All genuine silk must be professionally dry-cleaned to avoid destroying the fabric grain and finish.
 The Documented Reality: Modern washable silk utilizes specific weaves and finishes that tolerate gentle machine washing at home without fraying or falling apart.
 As Stewart observed during the podcast segment: “This is not going to fall apart. This is beautifully done.”
 How Quince Silk Essentials Compare
 The split-neck top is part of an expanded lineup of washable silk pieces gaining popularity alongside other celebrity favorites, including the brand’s cashmere spotted on actress Jessica Alba. Here is how the key washable silk pieces line up:

 Consumer Reaction and Fit Details
 Shoppers echo Stewart’s positive assessment, noting the material’s texture and versatility in everyday settings. Verified customer feedback highlights the soft hand-feel alongside practical sizing considerations.
 One buyer noted that the top provides a “rich, buttery feel,” recommending sizing down from a medium to a small for those who prefer a closer, more tailored fit. Another reviewer reported wearing the green variation to the workplace, noting an unprecedented volume of compliments.
 💬 With high-end basics becoming easier to maintain at home, stealth wealth style is shifting toward everyday utility.
